scope: host-only synthetic phase-code mechanics check; no camera data
algorithm: one-dimensional log-Gabor phase code with masked Hamming comparison and angular-shift search
coverage: angular shift recovered for a generated five-sample rotation
clipped sector reduced overlap while preserving low distance
one handcrafted distinct texture scored farther than the aligned same-texture sample
diagnostic consensus accepted three compatible samples, rejected a blank sample, and refused incomplete enrollment
limitations: These are deterministic toy patterns with known synthetic geometry, not human iris images or a representative genuine/impostor score distribution. They cannot set a match threshold, estimate false accept/reject rates, establish liveness, or support Android authentication.
publication: local only; no commit, push, or PR
